mainImage.alt: Large Iranian-flagged cargo ship M/V Touska seen from the deck of a U.S. Navy ship
mainImage.caption: A view of the Iranian-flagged cargo ship M/V Touska from the deck of a U.S. Navy ship in the Gulf of Oman, April 20, 2026. The U.S. Navy fired on the ship and seized it after it tried to breach the U.S. naval blockade of the Strait of Hormuz.
